Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(
    varSelectedHiveNode,
    {
        NodeId: cmpHiveNodeCard.NodeId,
        NodeNo: cmpHiveNodeCard.NodeNo,
        NodeTitle: cmpHiveNodeCard.NodeTitle,
        NodeSubtitle: cmpHiveNodeCard.NodeSubtitle,
        SubsystemCode: cmpHiveNodeCard.SubsystemCode,
        HealthScore: cmpHiveNodeCard.HealthScore,
        HealthStatus: cmpHiveNodeCard.HealthStatus,
        HealthColor: cmpHiveNodeCard.HealthColor,
        Progress: cmpHiveNodeCard.Progress,
        TrendDirection: cmpHiveNodeCard.TrendDirection,
        PressureLevel: cmpHiveNodeCard.PressureLevel,
        Total: cmpHiveNodeCard.Total,
        Overdue: cmpHiveNodeCard.Overdue,
        Blocked: cmpHiveNodeCard.Blocked,
        AtRisk: cmpHiveNodeCard.AtRisk
    }
)

If(
    cmpHiveNodeCard.HealthStatus = "Critical",
    "⚠ Critical",
    If(
        cmpHiveNodeCard.HealthStatus = "At Risk",
        "⚠ At Risk",
        cmpHiveNodeCard.HealthStatus
    )
)

With(
    {
        _color: Switch(
            cmpHiveNodeCard.HealthStatus,
            "Excellent", "#2F9E44",
            "Good", "#EAB308",
            "At Risk", "#F97316",
            "Critical", "#DC2626",
            "#64748B"
        )
    },
    "<svg width='82' height='82' viewBox='0 0 82 82' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
        <circle cx='41' cy='41' r='31' fill='none' stroke='#E5E7EB' stroke-width='8'/>
        <circle cx='41' cy='41' r='31' fill='none' stroke='" & _color & "' stroke-width='8'
            stroke-dasharray='" & Text(cmpHiveNodeCard.Progress * 1.76) & " 176'
            stroke-linecap='round'
            transform='rotate(-90 38 38)'/>
        <text x='38' y='37' text-anchor='middle' font-size='14' font-weight='700' fill='#0F172A'>" & cmpHiveNodeCard.Progress & "%</text>
        <text x='38' y='52' text-anchor='middle' font-size='9' fill='#64748B'>Progress</text>
    </svg>"
)

Switch(
    cmpHiveNodeCard.TrendDirection,
    "Improving", "↗ Improving",
    "Worsening", "↘ Worsening",
    "Stable", "→ Stable",
    "New", "• New",
    cmpHiveNodeCard.TrendDirection
)

Switch(
    cmpHiveNodeCard.TrendDirection,
    "Improving", ColorValue("#2F9E44"),
    "Worsening", ColorValue("#DC2626"),
    "Stable", ColorValue("#64748B"),
    ColorValue("#64748B")
)
